so often adverb

also so many times, as often, as many times, so frequently

classical

Liv. 2.13.2: mōverat eum subeunda dīmicātiō totiēns (Lewis & Short)
Cic. de Or. 1.251 (Lewis & Short)

totiēns (totiēs)

so often, so many times; with quotiēns, as often as

Examples

  • mōverat eum subeunda dīmicātiō totiēns

    the prospect of having to face the struggle so many times had shaken himLiv. 2.13.2 (Lewis & Short)

See also often, how often.
